description: Create Portfolio Management (PM) question data file and seed function, following the exact Corporate Issuers pattern
steps: Create src/features/question-bank/data/portfolio-management.ts with realistic CFA Level I Portfolio Management questions across 6 modules. Module question counts: Module 1 (56 questions), Module 2 (93), Module 3 (40), Module 4 (55), Module 5 (27), Module 6 (41). Total: 312 questions. Each question has id (pm-mN-qN format), questionText, 3 answerChoices with label A/B/C, difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard distribution), subject='Portfolio Management', reading=null, topic matching the module name, provider='cfa-portal', questionSourceFile=null. Export a flat array (portfolioManagementQuestions) and a modules object (portfolioManagementModules) with keys module1-module6 each having {name, questions}.

Create src/features/question-bank/utils/seed-portfolio-management.ts following the exact pattern from seed-corporate-issuers.ts. Use SEED_ATTEMPT_ID='pm-attempt-1', subject='Portfolio Management', seed value=256. Module scores: M1: 38/56, M2: 75/93, M3: 30/40, M4: 50/55, M5: 20/27, M6: 31/41. Overall: 244/312 (78%). completedAt: '2025-01-20T16:45:00Z'.

Wire seedPortfolioManagementAttempt() into dashboard-content.tsx, attempts-list-client.tsx, and recent-attempts-section.tsx following the same useEffect pattern. Import from '@/features/question-bank/utils/seed-portfolio-management' and call in the same useEffect blocks where seedCorporateIssuersAttempt() and seedFsaAttempt() are called.
